translationRepairs: Kangsheng served as a commander and followed Prince Zhangwu of Wei, Yuan Bin, to suppress the rebellion.
Kangsheng served as a commander and followed Yuan Bin, Prince Zhangwu, to suppress the rebellion.
Chinese 章武王彬 is the Northern Wei prince Yuan Bin (元彬); "of Wei" is redundant and the English name order is clearer as personal name then title.
Later Xiao Yan sent Army Commander Xu Ji from Yuzhou to raid the frontier. Kangsheng led his officers out to attack, defeated them, and captured Xu Ji alive.
Later Xiao Yan at Yuzhou (郁洲) sent Army Commander Xu Ji to raid the frontier. Kangsheng led his officers out to attack, defeated them, and captured Xu Ji alive.
Chinese 郁洲 is the coastal island/region Yuzhou, not the inland province often romanized the same way; clarifying the place avoids confusing it with Yang Province (揚州).
When they reached Longyou, Emperor Xiaoming died, and the army turned back.
When they reached Longyou, Emperor Shizong died, and the army turned back.
Chinese 世宗崩 is Emperor Shizong (Xuanwu, d. AD 515), not Xiaoming; the English temple/personal mix-up invents the wrong ruler.
When they reached Longyou, Emperor Xiaoming died, and the army withdrew.
When they reached Longyou, Emperor Shizong died, and the army withdrew.
Literal field likewise renders 世宗 as Xiaoming; correct temple name is Shizong.

In the third month of the second year of Zhengguang, Emperor Xiaozan held audience for Empress Dowager Ling in Xilin Garden. Civil and military officials sat in attendance, and when the wine had gone deep they danced in turn.

In the third month of the second year of Zhengguang, Emperor Suzong (Xiaoming) held audience for Empress Dowager Ling in Xilin Garden. Civil and military officials sat in attendance, and when the wine had gone deep they danced in turn.
肅宗 is Emperor Xiaoming’s temple name Suzong; “Xiaozan” is a malformed romanization not matching the Chinese.

At the start of Emperor Xiaoming's reign, Pei Shuye surrendered Shouchun to the court. Dayan, Xi Kangsheng, and others led the vanguard, and for his merit Dayan was enfeoffed as Founder Viscount of Ancheng County with a fief of three hundred households.

At the start of Emperor Shizong's reign, Pei Shuye surrendered Shouchun to the court. Dayan, Xi Kangsheng, and others led the vanguard, and for his merit Dayan was enfeoffed as Founder Viscount of Ancheng County with a fief of three hundred households.
Chinese 世宗 is Emperor Shizong (Xuanwu); Xiaoming is 肅宗. The English systematically mistranslates the temple name.

Emperor Xiaoming appointed Dayan Guard General, Provisionally General Who Pacifies the South, and Bearer of the Staff, commanding Army Commanders Cao Jing, Bing Qiu, Fan Lu, and other armies against Maoxian and his forces. Dayan routed them, beheaded Xiao Yan's General Who Assists the State Wang Hua and General of Dragon Cavalry Shen Tianhua, and captured or beheaded more than seven thousand.
